scoring_justification: Fixed strain ratios compared to paper-reported model results (CAL1 96.4%, CAL2 66.9%) with tolerance. Residual curves validated structurally because precise digitized curves are not available, and the structural checks (monotonic, crossover, final recovery) suffice for reproduction validation.

outputs.description: Fixed strain ratio for EXP1 and EXP2, compared to hidden gold values with a tolerance of ±2 percentage points.
Residual fixed strain ratio curves for EXP1 and EXP2. Checker verifies that exp1_ratio > exp2_ratio for all temperatures below 40°C and that the curves satisfy monotonicity and crossover properties.

output_contract.notes: Fixed strain ratios checked with exact_match (tolerance ±2 pp). Residual curves checked via structural_audit (EXP1 always above EXP2 below 40°C, monotonic, crossover).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold fixed strain ratios from paper's model simulation (CAL1 and CAL2)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's reported model results for EXP1 and EXP2 simulations.
